predecessors.name: Songhai Empire
predecessors.text: Dendi, the easternmost province of Songhai on the Niger: Tillabéri to Gaya (modern centres Gaya in Niger, Kamba in Nigeria, Malanville in Benin); the same outline as the songhai-empire dossier's last…

successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Dendi, the easternmost province of Songhai on the Niger: Tillabéri to Gaya (modern centres Gaya in Niger, Kamba in Nigeria, Malanville in Benin); the same outline as the songhai-empire dossier's last…

ledger.x: 1599: the Askia kingdom of Dendi on the Niger.

wars.name: Dendi war against the Saadi pasha
wars.outcome: Nuh resisted the Moroccan-backed pasha Mahmud ibn Zarqun in a two-year war; "In 1594 Mahmud was forced to discontinue the war and retreated".

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier, only Dendi's modern centres on the Niger.
